IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, loose blonde
hair walks through a bright indoor corridor. She
wears a fitted rust velvet button-front jacket with a
high collar, over a deep red floral velvet skirt with a
high-low hem. A gray backpack sits on her
shoulders, and tall burgundy buckled boots show at
the hem. Her expression is calm and serious. Soft,
cool interior light with a blurred background. Palette
of rust, burgundy, and warm gray. Warm and
nostalgic, in the style of an early-2000s film still.
